description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the FormatWithEducation class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It sets up test data and verifies the behavior of the getFormattedValue() method.

classes.name: FormatWithEducationTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the FormatWithEducation class and its method getFormattedValue() using PHPUnit.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and prepares the FormatWithEducation instance for testing.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue() method correctly formats education levels, returning 'PhD' for input 1 and null for input 5.
